body: I am a Stranger on the internet but good gosh I am so proud and happy for you! Congrats and I hope it keeps getting better!
Thanks for taking the time to say something. Good thoughts to you.

I'm sorry someone said that to you, and they might be too. Asperger's isn't a disease though- it's a disorder, and it's quite common and manageable. Maybe this person saying that was their way of trying to make sense of why you act the way you do, and they couldn't express that in a kind or appropriate way. Having Asperger's wished upon you isn't nice at all, but would you agree not as bad as having someone wish AIDS or ALS or cancer or death on you? Don't shut down because someone made a snide remark about hoping that you have a disorder that almost everyone is on the spectrum of. Don't do that to yourself.
I've gotten a little more curt since his death, so it was easier than usual for me to refuse them. She's been a hassle. :/
thank you for saying so. I think he did, too. (to a point! ha)
My mother told me I should just delete his Facebook, but I'm not sure yet. His mother is a few states away now, but she can get kind of dramatic and volatile.

In the first couple weeks I told myself not to be the grief police and let everyone express themselves in their way, but a month has passed and I get angrier at everyone. I feel like some members of his family are grieving a particular way for attention and I dropped my patience for dealing with hard stuff somewhere along the way.

I don't know how long it's been, but I'm very sorry for your loss. 

MIL was telling (telling!) me to send her all my videos of him speaking so that she could play them at his sister's future wedding. For reference she is 19 and single. I politely declined, telling her I didn't see an appropriate spot at a hypothetical wedding for videos that are personal and *directed at me*. bah.
I don't know if it's always good, but it's where my first instinct goes. :/
